nr : 0] log1p_exp_lp10_row;     if (estimate_fp == 1 && fp_by_row == 0) {       log1p_exp_lp10 = log1p_exp(lp10);       unocc = Ysite[a:b] .* lp10 - Nsite[a:b] .* log1p_exp_lp10;     } else if (estimate_fp == 1 && nr > 0) {       int r1 = r0 + nr - 1;       array[nr] int loc;       for (k in 1:nr) loc[k] = site2[r0 + k - 1] - a + 1;       vector[nr] lp10_row = lp10[loc] + Xfp2[r0:r1] * gamma_fp;       log1p_exp_lp10_row = log1p_exp(lp10_row);       vector[nr] l10 = y2v[r0:r1] .* lp10_row - n2v[r0:r1] .* log1p_exp_lp10_row;       for (i in 1:ns) {         int s = a + i - 1;         if (len2[s] > 0) unocc[i] = sum(segment(l10, start2[s] - r0 + 1, len2[s]));       }     }      // occupied branch, automated occasions     if (nr > 0 && use_glm == 1) {       // one GLM call per site: the product Z * alpha, the binomial       // log-likelihood and its gradient are computed in C++ without       // intermediate autodiff variables; lchoose_site removes the binomial       // constant. When the recorder is constant within sites the intercept       // is a scalar, which avoids one autodiff variable per row (1.6 times       // faster per gradient on the curiango data than the vector form)       vector[rows(alpha) - 1] slopes = alpha[2:rows(alpha)];       for (i in 1:ns) {         int s = a + i - 1;         if (len2[s] > 0) {           int q0 = start2[s];           int q1 = q0 + len2[s] - 1;           if (estimate_re == 1 && rec_by_site == 0) {             occ[i] = binomial_logit_glm_lpmf(y2[q0:q1] | n2[q0:q1], Z_slopes[q0:q1],                                              alpha[1] + d_det[s] + u[rec2[q0:q1]], slopes)                      - lchoose_site[s];           } else {             real intercept = d_det[s] + (estimate_re == 1 ? alpha[1] + u[rec_site[s]] : alpha[1]);             occ[i] = binomial_logit_glm_lpmf(y2[q0:q1] | n2[q0:q1], Z_slopes[q0:q1],                                              intercept, slopes) - lchoose_site[s];           }         }       }     } else if (nr > 0) {       // vectorized rows; log_inv_logit(x) = x - log1p_exp(x)       int r1 = r0 + nr - 1;       vector[nr] y = y2v[r0:r1];       vector[nr] n = n2v[r0:r1];       vector[nr] lp11 = Z[r0:r1] * alpha;       if (estimate_re == 1) lp11 += u[rec2[r0:r1]];       lp11 += d_det[site2[r0:r1]];       vector[nr] l11;       if (obs_confirm == 1) {         // log(1 - p11) = log(1 - s1) + log(1 - s0)         vector[nr] lq11;         if (fp_by_row == 1) {           lq11 = -log1p_exp(lp11) - log1p_exp_lp10_row;         } else {           array[nr] int loc;           for (k in 1:nr) loc[k] = site2[r0 + k - 1] - a + 1;           lq11 = -log1p_exp(lp11) - log1p_exp_lp10[loc];         }         l11 = y .* log1m_exp(lq11) + (n - y) .* lq11;       } else {         l11 = y .* lp11 - n .* log1p_exp(lp11);       }       for (i in 1:ns) {         int s = a + i - 1;         if (len2[s] > 0) occ[i] = sum(segment(l11, start2[s] - r0 + 1, len2[s]));       }     }     if (estimate_fp == 0) {       for (i in 1:ns) if (any_det2[a + i - 1] == 1) unocc[i] = negative_infinity();     }      // verified occasions: counts per site, or rows when the verified method     // has covariates (sorted by site, like the automated rows)     if (Kver_s == 0) {       occ += s1v[a:b] * log_inv_logit(delta0) + (n1v[a:b] - s1v[a:b]) * log1m_inv_logit(delta0);     } else {       int w0 = start1[a];       int nw = start1[b] + len1[b] - w0;       if (nw > 0) {         int w1 = w0 + nw - 1;         vector[nw] eta1 = delta0 + X1s[w0:w1] * delta_s;         vector[nw] l1 = y1v[w0:w1] .* eta1 - log1p_exp(eta1);         for (i in 1:ns) {           int s = a + i - 1;           if (len1[s] > 0) occ[i] += sum(segment(l1, start1[s] - w0 + 1, len1[s]));         }       }     }      // confirmed occasions (observation-confirmation design)     if (obs_confirm == 1) {       int q0 = start3[a];       int nq = start3[b] + len3[b] - q0;       if (nq > 0) {         int q1 = q0 + nq - 1;         vector[nq] lp11_3 = Z3[q0:q1] * alpha;         if (estimate_re == 1) lp11_3 += u[rec3[q0:q1]];         lp11_3 += d_det[site3[q0:q1]];         for (k in 1:nq) {           int i = site3[q0 + k - 1] - a + 1;           int v = v3[q0 + k - 1];           real ls1 = log_inv_logit(lp11_3[k]);           real lq1 = log1m_inv_logit(lp11_3[k]);
